task:
FIX THREE FOLLOW-UP REVIEW FINDINGS ON PR #798 (step 0 status action). Target branch codex/run-38011726130-1, expected head b890ace; fail closed and write nothing if it moved. Only scripts/operator/actions/v3-derived-lifecycle-status.sh, tests/test_v3_derived_lifecycle_status.py and docs/operations/v3-finder-production-rollout-state.md may change.

F1 (P2, ~line 466): a missing v3_meta.derived_product relation is silently recorded as derived_products: null while readiness can still be true. In the documented production baseline migration 006 and a READY system_search product exist, so a missing table is schema drift. CHANGE: when to_regclass('v3_meta.derived_product') is NULL add failure code derived_product_table_missing (status stopped, readiness false); keep derived_product_table_present=false in the receipt. Test it.

F2 (P2, doc ~line 205 + script): the doc tells the operator to multiply body-table per-row sizes by footprint.relations.n_live_tup, but that is a whole-relation estimate across retained generations, not the published generation's count. v3_derived.build_chunk carries per-chunk physical_bodies and eligible_opportunities (sql/v3/migrations/003_ratings_v4_derived.sql:82-94). CHANGE: extend the existing rows_by_generation ratings attribution query to also sum physical_bodies and eligible_opportunities per generation (report ratings_physical_bodies and ratings_eligible_opportunities alongside ratings_systems), and change the doc sentence so the operator multiplies 178 B/row by the published generation's ratings_physical_bodies and 188 B/row by its ratings_eligible_opportunities from rows_by_generation — not by n_live_tup. Update the canned psql stub and assertions in the test.

F3 (P2, ~line 736): when no mount destination matches /var/lib/postgresql the receipt records host_disk {mount_found: false} but inspection_complete/readiness can still be true, although footprint.host_disk.avail_bytes is required evidence for the capacity decision. CHANGE: add failure code postgres_data_mount_unresolved in that case (status stopped, readiness false). Test it (docker Mounts stub returning an unrelated mount).

VALIDATION: 1. bash -n the script  2. python -m pytest tests/test_v3_derived_lifecycle_status.py -q -p no:cacheprovider  3. ruff on the extracted heredoc body  4. git diff --name-only b890ace lists only the three allowed files. Commit message: 'ops: step 0 fails closed on missing product table or data mount; generation-scoped body counts for the capacity estimate'.
